	<div grid-col="x11" grid-pad="4" class=""><div style="text-align: left;"><h2><b>COMMUNAL FRUIT PRESS</b><br></h2><br>Good news for fruit lovers – we got some funding to buy a communal fruit press!<b></b><br>
<br>
The press’s name is ‘Clarke’ and it will be based at the beautiful Glengall Wharf Community Garden, just off Old Kent Road, in the east corner of Burgess Park.<br>
<br>
Over the summer, we’ll be practising making juices, ciders and more, thanks to kind donations from Tesco Old Kent Road and New Covent Garden Fruit and Veg Market.<br>
<br>
You can come and meet Clarke from <b>2-4pm this Sunday 26 July at the Glengall’s Plant and Bake Sale!<br></b>
<br>
We hope that together we can grow this project over the years, but right now there are 3 key ways you can get involved:<br>
<br>
<b>1. Become a Fruit Donor</b> – if you’re based in SE London and have a fruit tree with surplus fruit, let us know and we can add you to our map and timetable <br>
<br>
<b>2. Become a Picking Volunteer</b> – join a group of volunteers that will go on nice neighbourhood walks, picking and collecting fruit when the time is right <br>
<br>
<b>3. Become a Processing Volunteer</b> – join a group of people who want to experiment with making juices, brewing cider and all sorts of fruit-related cooking<br>
<br>
If you’re interested in any of the above, contact <a href="mailto:fat.studio.cic@gmail.com">fat.studio.cic@gmail.com</a> and we’ll invite you to a meet-up. <br>
<br>
Let’s get together and press fruit!!!<br>
<br>
Thanks to London National Park City for the funding, Angie at Glengall Wharf Community Garden for the support<br>
and Madison Bryan from Old Kent Road Tesco for the fruit donation!<br></div>
